args.body:
Dear Billing Contact,

We have updated our records to send all future invoices to this email address. Additionally, we have processed a $120 refund for the late fee associated with your account. The refund should appear on your original payment method within 5-7 business days.

If you have any questions, please let us know.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
